mapper.select: SELECT /*selectHdForm*/ DECODE(MAX(BTOA_DATE), '', MAX((SELECT COM_NAME_LOC FROM ICOMCMPY WHERE COM_CODE=A.BUYER AND STATUS <> 'D')), MAX((SELECT COM_NAME_LOC FROM ICOMCMPY WHERE COM_CODE=A.BUYER AND STATUS <> 'D')) || ' (의뢰일 : ' || MAX(TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(A.BTOA_DATE, 'YYYYMMDD'),'YYYY/MM/DD')) || ')' ) AS BUYER_NAME , MAX(A.BTOA_USER_NAME) AS BTOA_USER_NAME , MAX(A.BTOA_USER_TEL) AS BTOA_USER_TEL , MAX(A.BTOA_USER_MAIL) AS BTOA_USER_MAIL FROM KEPRQDT A WHERE A.BUYER=#{st_buyer} AND A.QUOTATION_NO=#{st_quotation_no} AND A.REVISION=#{st_revision} AND A.STATUS <> 'D'

SELECT /* selectTotalPopList */ X.REVISION, X.BUYER_ITEM_NO, X.DESCRIPTION, X.ITEM_QTY, X.MAKER_NAME, X.AGENT, X.GR_FLAG, X.CONFIRM_USER_ID, X.BTOA_REMARK, X.IMAGE_KEY, X.QUOTATION_SEQ, X.SOURCING_STATUS, X.SPECIFICATION, X.UNIT_MEASURE, X.ORIGIN_NAME, X.BUYER_TARGET_PRICE, X.PO_FLAG, X.CANCEL_REMARK, ( SELECT DECODE(COUNT(*), 0, '', COUNT(*)) FROM BNTNEGOHISTORY H WHERE H.BUYER=X.BUYER AND H.QUOTATION_NO=X.QUOTATION_NO AND H.QUOTATION_SEQ=X.QUOTATION_SEQ AND H.REVISION=X.REVISION ) AS NEGO_COUNT FROM ( SELECT MAX(A.REVISION) AS REVISION, MAX(A.BUYER_ITEM_NO) AS BUYER_ITEM_NO, MAX(A.DESCRIPTION) AS DESCRIPTION, MAX(A.ITEM_QTY) AS ITEM_QTY, MAX(A.MAKER_NAME) AS MAKER_NAME, MAX(A.AGENT_NAME) AS AGENT, '' AS GR_FLAG, MAX((SELECT USER_NAME_LOC FROM ICOMLUSR WHERE USER_ID=A.CONFIRM_USER_ID)) AS CONFIRM_USER_ID, MAX(A.BTOA_REMARK) AS BTOA_REMARK, MAX(A.IMAGE_KEY) AS IMAGE_KEY, MAX(A.QUOTATION_SEQ) AS QUOTATION_SEQ, CASE WHEN MAX(A.RECV_FLAG)='GD' THEN '견적취소' ELSE CASE WHEN MAX(A.RECV_FLAG)='CC' THEN '장바구니' ELSE CASE WHEN MAX(A.RECV_FLAG)='CM' THEN '합의완료' ELSE CASE WHEN MAX(A.RECV_FLAG) = 'GS' THEN '결재진행중' ELSE CASE WHEN MAX(A.RECV_FLAG) = 'GR' THEN '결재반려' ELSE CASE WHEN MAX(A.KEP_USER_ID) IS NULL THEN '견적의뢰' ELSE CASE WHEN MAX(A.BTOA_NEGO_PRICE)<>0 AND MAX(A.ATOB_UNIT_PRICE)=0 AND MAX(A.ATOB_SEND_FLAG)='Y' THEN 'Nego견적의뢰' ELSE CASE WHEN MAX(A.ATOB_UNIT_PRICE)=0 AND MAX(A.BTOA_NEGO_PRICE)=0 AND MAX(A.ATOB_SEND_FLAG)='N' THEN '견적진행중' ELSE CASE WHEN MAX(A.ATOB_UNIT_PRICE)=0 AND MAX(A.BTOA_NEGO_PRICE)<>0 AND MAX(A.ATOB_SEND_FLAG)='N' THEN 'Nego진행중' ELSE CASE WHEN MAX(A.ATOB_UNIT_PRICE)<>0 AND MAX(A.BTOA_NEGO_PRICE)=0 AND MAX(A.ATOB_SEND_FLAG)='Y' AND MAX(B.BID_SUCCESS_FLAG)='Y' THEN '단가합의대상' ELSE CASE WHEN MAX(A.BTOA_NEGO_PRICE)<>0 AND MAX(A.ATOB_UNIT_PRICE)<>0 AND MAX(A.ATOB_SEND_FLAG)='Y' AND MAX(B.BID_SUCCESS_FLAG)='Y' THEN 'Nego합의대상' END END END END END END END END END END END AS SOURCING_STATUS, MAX(A.SPECIFICATION) AS SPECIFICATION, MAX(A.UNIT_MEASURE) AS UNIT_MEASURE, MAX((SELECT TEXT2 FROM ICOMCOD1 WHERE TYPE='M001' AND CODE=A.ORIGIN_NAME)) AS ORIGIN_NAME, MAX(A.BUYER_TARGET_PRICE) BUYER_TARGET_PRICE, '' AS PO_FLAG, MAX(A.CANCEL_REMARK) AS CANCEL_REMARK, MAX(A.BUYER) AS BUYER, MAX(A.QUOTATION_NO) AS QUOTATION_NO FROM KEPRQDT A, KEPQTDT B WHERE A.BUYER=#{st_buyer} AND A.QUOTATION_NO=#{st_quotation_no} AND A.REVISION=#{st_revision} AND A.BUYER=B.BUYER(+) AND A.QUOTATION_NO=B.QUOTATION_NO(+) AND A.QUOTATION_SEQ=B.QUOTATION_SEQ(+) AND A.REVISION=B.REVISION(+) AND A.STATUS IN ('C','R') AND B.STATUS(+) <> 'D' AND B.STATUS(+) <> 'O' GROUP BY A.BUYER, A.QUOTATION_NO, A.QUOTATION_SEQ, A.REVISION ) X
